impact.title: Community Impact
impact.subtitle: Authoritative metrics computed strictly from verified completed handovers. No invented statistics.
impact.zeroStateBody: Our regional network in Karnataka is beginning operations. Real-time statistics will populate automatically as donors and recipients complete verified food handovers.
impact.calculationMethod: Transparent Calculation Method: 1 meal portion is defined as 0.4 kg standard nutritional serving portion (FSSAI/FAO baseline). 1 kg food waste diverted avoids 2.5 kg CO2e greenhouse gas emissions (UNEP factor).

howItWorks.title: How FoodBridge Works
howItWorks.subtitle: A safe, transparent path for surplus food in three steps

step1.title: List surplus food
step1.description: Donors specify food item, preparation time, safe-use window, quantity, allergens, and pickup location.

step2.title: Find a suitable recipient
step2.description: Our matching engine identifies verified recipients strictly by material suitability, geographic radius, and available additional capacity.

step3.title: Arrange pickup & confirm
step3.description: Direct pickup or a verified delivery partner carries the listing. Handover and receipt are confirmed for complete traceability.

categories.title: Verified Recipient Categories
categories.subtitle: Strict suitability separation ensures surplus food reaches only the appropriate, verified destination.
categories.safetyBanner: Food safety is non-negotiable. Human and animal destinations are never interchangeable with waste processing.

human.title: Human-Food Recipients
human.description: Verified NGOs, children's homes, eldercare shelters, and community kitchens equipped with safe food storage.
human.accepts: Accepts: Fresh prepared meals, packaged goods, clean produce within safe-use deadline.

animal.title: Animal-Food Recipients
animal.description: Registered cattle shelters (gaushalas), animal sanctuaries, and approved veterinary care facilities.
animal.accepts: Accepts: Vegetarian surplus, unseasoned grains, fruits, safe raw vegetable trims.

compost.title: Composting Facilities
compost.description: Authorized decentralized and community composting hubs converting organic residue into organic soil conditioner.
compost.accepts: Accepts: Vegetable peels, coffee grounds, garden greens, spoiled uncooked organic matter.

biogas.title: Biogas Plants
biogas.description: Anaerobic biomethanation units transforming bulk biodegradable organic residues into clean cooking gas and power.
biogas.accepts: Accepts: Bulk mixed organic scraps, wet kitchen waste, high-moisture biological byproducts.
